kind: independent read-only review of H743 CSTART rs and corrected two-stage regression plan
source_scope: No source changes, configuration, compilation, test execution, staging or commit by reviewer. Original S0.2 remains BLOCKED pending new source-bound TDD and final independent review.

official_reference.register_access: section 1.2, text lines 4912-4913: rs permits read/set; writing 0 has no effect
official_reference.CSTART: CR1 bit 9, rs, pages 2215-2216; software 1 starts, EOT or accepted suspension clears by hardware
official_reference.CSUSP: CR1 bit 10, write command, reads 0; page 2216
official_reference.completion: section 50.4.12 page 2177; finite TSIZE>0 TXC/EOT match, suspend waits CSTART clear

confirmed_problem: Read-modify-write of CR1 carrying sampled CSTART=1 can reissue the software-start command after asynchronous EOT cleared it. The specification does not supply precedence for simultaneous CSTART=1 and CSUSP=1; a model must not resolve that ambiguity by treating CSTART as read-only.
minimal_command_rule: Emit CSUSP with CSTART masked to 0. Under documented rs semantics this does not clear an ongoing CSTART=1, and avoids requesting a new transfer. Preserve all required other control bits.
two_stage_TDD: With the old production CSUSP RMW, record actual MMIO command values and require CSUSP writes never contain CSTART=1. Execute the whole regression module for genuine RED before the minimal mask fix and whole GREEN. Do not simulate an undocumented priority for an unsafe command.

On the safe command implementation and the old strict SUSP-only predicate, inject an external finite EOT completion before command acceptance, producing CSTART=0/EOT=1/TXC=1/SUSP=0. Execute the whole module for genuine RED, then minimally accept CSTART=0 and (SUSP or (TSIZE>0 and EOT and TXC)), followed by fresh complete whole results.

Retain independent quiet delay, RX-prefix accounting, SUSP-clear readback, SPE-clear readback, CS-high readback, SCK GPIO handoff, reset, and active/caller loan retention on every failed withdrawal. Zero TSIZE and one-status-only negative cases remain nonreturning/borrow-retained conservative tests.

prior_provisional_evidence.limitation: Executed using the prior model assumption; immutable failure history only, not closure of corrected rs command semantics. The original plan fixture sentence that stale CSTART cannot restart is invalid and must remain historical rather than current.
